name: Acme Manufacturing, Ikeja

zones.name: Security at the Main Gate
zones.hint: Talk to Security at the gate

gate.text: An okada drops you at the gate. Your hands are full and you have no ID. Security says: "Go in, I know you."

o.t: Thank him and walk in
o.why: If you never sign in, nobody will know you are on site, so the muster count misses you in a fire.

o.t: Wait, sign the visitor register and collect a pass
o.why: Correct. Security controls who is inside so that everyone can be accounted for in an emergency.

reception.text: "Welcome! Here are your safety boots, hi-vis vest, hard hat, goggles and ear plugs." The boots are a bit tight.

o.t: Leave the PPE, "na only small time I go spend"
o.why: Accident no dey give notice. Without ear plugs and goggles, noisy areas will now damage your hearing.

o.t: Ask for the correct size and wear everything
o.why: Correct. PPE only works if you wear it, and it must fit. Your character is now wearing PPE.

admin.text: On the staircase, a cleaner has just mopped. There is no wet-floor sign and you are carrying files with both hands.

o.t: Rush down, you are late
o.why: Slips, trips and falls are among the most common workplace injuries. Hold the rail.

o.t: Hold the handrail, go slowly and tell the cleaner to put up a sign
o.why: Correct. You protected yourself and the next person.

canteen.text: You smell gas near the kitchen burners. The cook is about to strike a match: "Make I light am, food don late."

o.t: Ignore it, cooks know their work
o.why: A gas leak plus a flame can cause an explosion.

o.t: Shout "STOP, no fire!", don't touch switches, open the windows, get people out and report it
o.why: Correct. No flames or switches, ventilate, evacuate and report.

workshop.text: Someone is grinding metal. Sparks are flying and the machine is very loud. You need to pass through to the store.

o.t: Pass quickly without goggles or ear plugs
o.why: Grinding sparks and chips damage eyes, and loud noise damages hearing permanently.

o.t: Put on goggles and ear plugs, wait for a pause, then pass behind the screen
o.why: Correct. Wear the right PPE for the area.

chemical.text: You find a drink bottle with clear liquid in it and no label on the chemical shelf.

o.t: Smell it to find out what it is
o.why: Never smell or taste an unknown chemical.

o.t: Don't touch it. Report it so it can be labelled or disposed of safely
o.why: Correct. Every chemical needs a label and a safety data sheet (SDS).

diesel.text: A contractor near the diesel tanks lights a cigarette: "Diesel no dey catch fire like petrol."

o.t: Stand with him and gist
o.why: Diesel vapour, spills and nearby fuels can ignite. No smoking near fuel.

o.t: Ask him to put it out, show him the No Smoking sign and report it
o.why: Correct. Speaking up protects everyone on site.

warehouse.text: "Abeg climb that rack and bring the top box. No time for ladder, the customer dey wait!"

o.t: Climb the rack
o.why: You fell from height. Falls from height are among the top killers at work.

o.t: "I no fit do am like that." Use your Stop-Work right and get a ladder or order picker
o.why: Correct. Everyone has the right to stop unsafe work, even when Oga is the one asking.

generator.text: The gen is running, the door is shut and a colleague is sleeping inside on a carton.

o.t: Leave him to rest
o.why: Gen fumes contain carbon monoxide. You cannot smell it, and it kills people who are sleeping. Na quiet killer be gen smoke.

o.t: Open the door, wake him, bring him to fresh air and report
o.why: Correct. Ventilate, remove the person and report.

loading.text: A truck is at the bay. The loader is inside the trailer, the driver is in the cab with the engine running, and there are no wheel chocks.

o.t: Start loading, the driver knows we're working
o.why: If the driver pulls away while someone is inside, that person falls or gets crushed.

o.t: Engine off, keys to the bay supervisor, chock the wheels, then load
o.why: Correct. Secure the vehicle before anyone works on it.

carpark.text: BEEP BEEP. A van is reversing towards you. There is no banksman, and your path goes right behind it.

o.t: Run behind it quickly
o.why: The driver cannot see behind the van. Reversing vehicles kill people every year.

o.t: Stop, step aside where the driver can see you, and wait until it has parked
o.why: Correct. Keep out of a reversing vehicle's path.

muster.text: "This is the Muster Point. If the fire alarm rings, where will you go?"

o.t: To my car, so I can leave quickly
o.why: The muster point is where you are counted. If you are missing, rescuers may go in looking for you.

o.t: Straight here, and I report to the fire warden
o.why: Correct. Remember this spot. You may need it soon.

electrical_electrician.text: "Change that breaker now. The panel is live, but no permit, we can't stop production!"

o.t: Work on it live, "e no go take time"
o.why: You were electrocuted. Never work on live equipment.

o.t: Get a permit, isolate the supply, lock and tag it (LOTO), test it is dead, then work
o.why: Correct. Isolate, lock, tag, try. Production can wait; your life cannot.

electrical_default.text: The door marked "DANGER – Authorised Persons Only" is open and the panel is humming. A friend says: "Come see inside."

o.t: Go in and look
o.why: High voltage can arc. Only authorised people may enter.

o.t: Stay out, close the door if it is safe to do so, and report it
o.why: Correct. Respect the signs.

nepa.text: Power is gone and the compound goes dark. Someone wants to "back-feed" the office by plugging the small gen straight into a wall socket.

o.t: Help him plug it in
o.why: Back-feeding can electrocute people working on the lines and can cause a fire.

o.t: Stop him. Only the changeover switch should be used, by an electrician
o.why: Correct. Use the proper changeover.

rain.text: The yard is flooding and water is moving towards the electrical room door.

o.t: Wade through to get to the canteen faster
o.why: Water and electricity kill. You also cannot see open drains under flood water.

o.t: Keep away, warn others and call the emergency number
o.why: Correct. Warn, keep away, report.

hazards.t: Frayed extension cable across the path
Oily rags piled next to a hot pipe

advanced.title: Advanced Site Course
advanced.about: Work at height, confined space, hot work, chemical spill, first aid, manual handling and journey management.

zones.name: Scaffold at the Generator House
zones.hint: Fix the light on the scaffold

zones.name: Manhole (confined space)
zones.hint: Check the pump in the manhole

zones.name: Welding near the drums
zones.hint: See the welder near the drums

zones.name: Heavy cartons at the bay
zones.hint: Move the cartons at the Loading Bay

zones.name: Company pickup trip
zones.hint: Plan the trip in the company pickup

height.text: You must fix a light 4 metres up. The scaffold tag is RED and a toe board is missing. Your harness is in the store, five minutes away.

o.t: Climb up quickly and hold the frame
o.why: You fell. A red tag means the scaffold is not safe to use. Falls from height kill more workers than almost anything else.

o.t: Stand on a plastic chair on the scaffold base instead
o.why: Chairs and drums are not work platforms. They tip over.

o.t: Don't use it. Get the scaffold inspected (green tag), wear a harness clipped to an anchor point, then climb with three points of contact
o.why: Correct. Only use a scaffold with a green tag, and protect yourself from a fall with a harness on an anchor point.

confined.text: A pump in the manhole has stopped. Your colleague wants to climb down: "Na just two metres, I go comot sharp sharp."

o.t: Go down with him so he is not alone
o.why: Gas in the manhole made you both collapse. Most people who die in confined spaces are the ones who go in to help.

o.t: Tie a rope on him and let him go in quickly
o.why: A rope does not protect him from toxic gas or lack of oxygen. The air must be tested first.

o.t: Stop. Nobody goes in without a permit, a gas test, fresh air blown in, a standby man at the top and a rescue plan
o.why: Correct. Test the air, ventilate, keep a standby person outside and have a rescue plan before anyone enters.

hotwork.text: A welder is about to weld a bracket. Diesel drums and oily rags are three metres away, and there is no fire extinguisher.

o.t: Let him start. Sparks don't go that far
o.why: Welding sparks can fly more than 10 metres and smoulder for an hour before a fire starts.

o.t: Stop the job. Hot work needs a permit: move the fuel and rags at least 11 metres away or cover them, have an extinguisher ready, and keep a fire watch during and for 30 minutes after
o.why: Correct. A hot work permit, a clear area, an extinguisher and a fire watch prevent most welding fires.

spill.text: A drum has tipped over. A chemical with a sharp smell is spreading across the walkway towards the drain.

o.t: Wash it into the drain with plenty of water
o.why: That pollutes the drain and the environment, and some chemicals react with water.

o.t: Wipe it up with a rag and your bare hands
o.why: Never touch an unknown chemical without the right gloves and eye protection.

o.t: Warn people and keep them back, read the label and safety data sheet (SDS), put on the right PPE, use the spill kit to stop it reaching the drain, and report it
o.why: Correct. Protect people first, then contain the spill with the spill kit, then report.

firstaid.text: A worker has fallen off a ladder. He is awake, but his arm is bleeding heavily.

o.t: Lift him up and walk him to your car to go to hospital
o.why: Moving him can make hidden injuries worse, and he keeps losing blood on the way.

o.t: Put sand or powder on the wound to stop the blood
o.why: That causes infection and does not stop heavy bleeding.

o.t: Check it is safe, shout for the first aider and call 112, wear gloves, press hard on the wound with a clean cloth and keep him still
o.why: Correct. Keep yourself safe, get help, and stop the bleeding with firm pressure.

manual.text: Oga says: "Carry these four cartons to the bay in one trip." Together they weigh about 40 kg.

o.t: Bend over and lift them all at once
o.why: Lifting a heavy load with a bent back is the main cause of back injuries at work.

o.t: Use a trolley or split the load. Bend your knees, keep your back straight and the load close, and don't twist
o.why: Correct. Avoid heavy lifts where you can, and lift with good technique when you must.

journey.text: You must go to Sagamu for a delivery. It is 6 pm, the driver worked a double shift, the seat belt is broken, and he says he will "just reply WhatsApp" on the way.

o.t: Go. Sagamu no far
o.why: The tired driver crashed at night on the expressway, and you had no seat belt. Road crashes are a top cause of work deaths in Nigeria.

o.t: Stop the trip until the belt is fixed. Follow the journey plan: a rested driver, no phone while driving, travel in daylight, and call to check in when you arrive
o.why: Correct. Journey management means a fit driver, a safe vehicle, a planned route and no phone at the wheel.

oga.title: Oga Mode
oga.about: You are the supervisor. Spot unsafe acts and stop them fast.

incidents.name: Worker without a hard hat at the Warehouse
incidents.text: A worker is stacking cartons under the high racks with no hard hat.

o.t: Stop the job, get him a hard hat, and only then let him continue
Shout from far away and keep walking
Ignore it. He has been doing this job for years

incidents.harm: A carton fell on the worker's head.

incidents.name: Smoking near the diesel tanks
incidents.text: A driver is smoking right next to the diesel tanks.

o.t: Tell him to put it out now and move to the smoking area, then report it
Wait until he finishes the cigarette
Leave it. Diesel does not burn easily

incidents.harm: A fire started at the tank farm.

incidents.name: Worker on the phone in the forklift lane
incidents.text: A worker is texting while walking along the forklift lane, away from the zebra crossing.

o.t: Stop him, move him onto the walkway, and remind him to cross only at the zebra crossing with the phone away
Hoot at him like a driver
It is fine, the forklift will stop

incidents.name: Grinding without goggles at the Workshop
incidents.text: A fitter is grinding metal with no goggles. Sparks are flying.

o.t: Stop the grinding and make him wear goggles and a face shield before he continues
Tell him to close his eyes when sparks come
Ignore it. The job is almost done

incidents.harm: A metal chip went into the fitter's eye.

incidents.name: Fire exit being blocked at Reception
incidents.text: A worker is stacking pallets in front of the fire exit door at Reception.

o.t: Stop him and have the pallets moved to the marked storage area. Fire exits must stay clear
Let it stay until tomorrow
Put a sign on the pallets saying "Fire exit"

incidents.harm: In a later drill, people were trapped behind the blocked exit.

incidents.name: Bad lifting at the Loading Bay
incidents.text: A new worker is lifting a heavy sack with a bent back and twisting as he turns.

o.t: Stop him, show him how to lift with bent knees and a straight back, and get a trolley or a second person
Tell him to lift faster so it hurts less
Leave him, he is young and strong

incidents.name: Unsafe ladder at the Generator House
incidents.text: A worker is on a ladder at the Generator House. Nobody is holding it, and it is standing on an oil patch.

o.t: Get him down, clean the spill, and have someone foot the ladder or tie it before he climbs again
Hold the ladder yourself and keep him working while the oil is there
Ignore it. It is a short ladder

incidents.harm: The ladder slipped and the worker fell.

incidents.name: Decanting chemicals without gloves
incidents.text: A cleaner is pouring a strong chemical into a drink bottle with bare hands and no goggles.

o.t: Stop her. Use the right labelled container, gloves and goggles, and check the safety data sheet
Tell her to be careful and continue
Help her pour it faster

incidents.harm: The chemical splashed onto the cleaner's hands and face.
